title: Points That Intersect With Cars
summary: Given a 0-indexed 2D integer array nums where each element is a car's start and end coordinates, return the count of unique integer points on the line that are covered by any car.
statement: Given a 0-indexed 2D integer array nums where each element is a car's start and end coordinates, return the count of unique integer points on the line that are covered by any car.
constraints: Each closed interval [start,end] marks every integer point from start through end.
Return the number of distinct marked integer points.
hints: A set directly represents distinct covered integer coordinates.
For every interval, add the inclusive range start through end.
Every covered coordinate is inserted at least once, and set uniqueness ensures overlapping intervals contribute it only once.
editorial: Every covered coordinate is inserted at least once, and set uniqueness ensures overlapping intervals contribute it only once.

tests.explanation: Together the intervals cover every integer from one through seven.
The disjoint intervals contain three and four integer points, totaling seven.
